description: 同一份示例报告的四种完整展开布局，内容与数据相同。

variants.label: 双栏分析
variants.detail: Layout 01 — TWO-COLUMN ANALYSIS. Long complete report with a balanced analytical overview. Immediately below breadcrumb/title, a 290px tall wide overview glass card divided into two clear halves: left a small "测评结果" label, large result name "协作型队友", the hero sentence, compact score pill 78.80 / 100, and a small glass ribbon emblem; right a large clear FIVE-axis lavender radar chart on dark graphite. Below it, render "维度解析" as five spacious expanded full-width horizontal rows, each row has a short purple line icon, dimension name and paragraph on the left, a precise score and a short corresponding lavender bar on the right. Below the five rows, side-by-side "你的协作优势" and "值得留意" cards, two concise entries each. Then a wide actions panel with all three numbered steps shown vertically. Finish with a wide compact share panel, one summary card and the actions. This version prioritizes clean comparison of dimensions and fluent reading, the radar and numerical detail have the strongest visual focus. Keep top art modest, show the entire report.
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a high-fidelity desktop web UI concept, the fully EXPANDED COMPLETE REPORT page for the existing MeetMyWorld Chinese assessment marketplace.
Output: exactly ONE separate finished webpage screenshot. Long portrait canvas, logically 1440px wide by approximately 2100px tall. Render the complete page from header to footer, including all expanded analytical content; no crop, no device, no perspective, no browser chrome, no collage, no extra designer captions outside the website. Crisp readable Simplified Chinese typesetting, professional visual hierarchy, ample spacing.

Input images: Image 1 is the CURRENT ADOPTED MARKETPLACE HOME PAGE, the authoritative visual style reference. Image 2 is an existing product detail page, supporting reference for the purple glass artwork and product continuity. Both are style references only, not edit targets. Build a NEW report page.
Visual identity: accurately match the HOME PAGE more than the product-detail sample. Near-black #101118 background, graphite #1B1D27 and #24252F translucent frosted glass panels, milky pastel lavender #D5A7EE pill actions with dark text, white large headings and cool gray secondary type. Fine silver-gray borders, 24px rounded corners, thin cool cyan-white curved edge at bottom left and lavender-white edge at bottom right. Muted sage glow at bottom left and lilac at right, extremely faint orbital grid behind the content. Minimal refined lighting, no saturated neon, no visual clutter. Abstract translucent lavender glass ribbon with a floating clear sphere can decorate a compact result header. Keep artwork away from text and charts.
App shell: exact same 72px top header as the HOME PAGE, a small lavender circular waveform symbol alone at left (DO NOT add a wordmark beside the symbol), "发现", rounded search field "搜索测试、场景或关键词", moon outline, "我的空间", lavender "登录 / 注册". Preserve the narrow outer icon rail. Below the header, use a large rounded unified glass workspace with an integrated 244px left sidebar titled "我的空间", items "应用商城", "我的应用", "我的报告", "我的收藏", "使用帮助". Highlight ONLY "我的报告". Sidebar and main report live within one softly connected glass surface as on the homepage, not unrelated separate app containers. The report reading area sits to the right, width about 990px, with consistent 24–32px gutters. Fine footer "meetmyworld © 2026".

State: the report has already been generated. Every report content section is fully expanded and visible. NO locked panels, NO blur, NO "解锁完整报告", NO "查看完整报告" button, NO "展开" buttons, NO loading, NO payment/redemption form, NO questionnaire. The top of the report has "返回我的报告", "伴侣协作体检 · 完整报告", a small obvious badge "示例报告", and "数据为设计示意". The report refers to the SAME finished assessment and result in all four variants.
Content and exact values, do not invent numbers:
Result type "协作型队友".
Hero sentence "你们擅长一起扛事，也值得给彼此多一点回应。"
Summary explanation "你们在分工与边界上较有默契。意见不合时，可以先回应感受，再讨论方案。"
Overall "协作倾向" score "78.80 / 100", clearly a score, NEVER a percentile or health diagnosis.
Five dimensions, all on a 0–100 scale:
"家务主动性" 82.00
"承诺兑现" 76.00
"共同决策" 80.00
"沟通修复" 68.00
"边界尊重" 88.00
If using a radar chart, exactly FIVE axes, exactly these names, consistent chart shape and scale. If using bars, lengths correspond to these five values. No decorative fake graphs.
Section "维度解析": show all five rows/cards EXPANDED, each with its dimension name, score, and the exact short explanation below. These explanations are required:
家务主动性: "愿意主动分担，也能看见日常任务。"
承诺兑现: "大多数约定会跟进，变化时可以更早告知。"
共同决策: "倾向一起讨论，让双方都参与选择。"
沟通修复: "争执后需要缓冲，也需要明确的回应。"
边界尊重: "能为彼此保留独处与休息的空间。"
Section "你的协作优势": "主动分担" with "愿意把共同生活当成两个人的事。"; "尊重空间" with "理解彼此需要独处和休息。"
Section "值得留意": "情绪回应" with "讨论解决办法前，先确认彼此的感受。"; "提前告知" with "无法兑现约定时，及时说明变化。"
Section "给你们的行动建议": three clear numbered expanded steps:
"01 每周一次分工对齐" and "用十分钟确认下周的共同任务。"
"02 冲突时先回应感受" and "先说我听见了，再一起找办法。"
"03 给彼此留出休息时间" and "约定可以安心独处的时段。"
Section "分享你的发现": a small lavender summary share card showing only "协作型队友" and a short result sentence. Nearby lavender primary pill "保存分享卡", secondary outline "返回商城". A quiet sentence "分享卡仅包含结果摘要". No QR, no report links, no personal account information.
A quiet line "群体参考：样本不足，暂不展示比例" may appear as a tiny informational row, never make up other-user counts or percentages.
Bottom small disclaimer "趣味自测，仅供娱乐与自我观察。"
Typography: modern clean Noto Sans SC-like Chinese sans-serif, clear 38px major titles, 24px section headings, 16px body text at the logical 1440px width. Make every heading and value legible and intentional. Use white body copy with gray supporting copy, warm and calm presentation. Do not dump long unreadable pseudo-Chinese paragraphs. Do not alter the existing product name, five dimension names, or score values. Do not add commerce banners or unrelated product recommendations.

Layout 01 — TWO-COLUMN ANALYSIS. Long complete report with a balanced analytical overview. Immediately below breadcrumb/title, a 290px tall wide overview glass card divided into two clear halves: left a small "测评结果" label, large result name "协作型队友", the hero sentence, compact score pill 78.80 / 100, and a small glass ribbon emblem; right a large clear FIVE-axis lavender radar chart on dark graphite. Below it, render "维度解析" as five spacious expanded full-width horizontal rows, each row has a short purple line icon, dimension name and paragraph on the left, a precise score and a short corresponding lavender bar on the right. Below the five rows, side-by-side "你的协作优势" and "值得留意" cards, two concise entries each. Then a wide actions panel with all three numbered steps shown vertically. Finish with a wide compact share panel, one summary card and the actions. This version prioritizes clean comparison of dimensions and fluent reading, the radar and numerical detail have the strongest visual focus. Keep top art modest, show the entire report.

variants.label: 横幅叙事
variants.detail: Layout 02 — WIDE HERO AND NARRATIVE REPORT. Long complete report with a distinctive broad horizontal result banner about 270px tall. The left 65% of the banner has dark-to-lilac transition, a small "测评结果" label, large "协作型队友", the hero sentence in two readable lines, and a compact 78.80 / 100 score chip; the right 35% carries the same translucent purple glass ribbon and floating sphere from the reference on a pale lavender background. BELOW the hero, a spacious full-width "结果解读" glass reading panel with the summary explanation and a tiny quiet group reference row. Next a five-column compact numeric strip titled "五个协作维度", with the exact five names and values, NO radar here. Below it, "维度解析" is a readable editorial panel with five fully expanded narrative rows; each row has a lavender dimension label, accurate slim bar and score, and one short explanation paragraph. The following row contains the two cards for "你的协作优势" and "值得留意". Actions appear in three horizontal equal-width cards with large subtle 01 02 03 numbers, titles, and one sentence each. Finish a refined horizontal share-card panel. This version should feel warm and narrative with a strong result hero and spacious typography. Display every report section fully.
